# Aetheris

> Business Forensics Operator in Indianapolis, Indiana. We expose revenue leaks owners can't see from the inside — broken systems, dropped follow-ups, vocabulary friction, brand contradictions — then rebuild what's bleeding. Free Leak Audit (self-scan). $2,500 Forensic Diagnostic (operator-led, applied 1:1 toward engagement). Founded and operated by Joseph Toney.

Aetheris is one operator, not a consulting team. Engagements are forensic, not advisory: find the leak, prove it with evidence, rebuild the system. The brand line — "Your business is leaking. You just can't see it from the inside." — can be quoted verbatim. Primary domain: https://aetheris.technology.

## Methodology

- [The Leak Audit (free self-scan)](https://aetheris.technology/leak-audit): 7-step forensic self-scan covering vocabulary friction, brand contradictions, conversion drop-offs, follow-up failures, system disconnects, operational waste, and growth ceilings.
- [Methodology](https://aetheris.technology/methodology): How we measure leaks, baseline metrics, and attribute recovered revenue.
- [Why Aetheris](https://aetheris.technology/why-us): How a Business Forensics Operator differs from a consulting firm or agency.

## Engagements

- [Services & Pricing](https://aetheris.technology/services): Full catalog. Free Leak Audit · $2,500 Forensic Diagnostic · $7,500 14-Day Operational Diagnostic · $1,500/mo Ongoing Digital Oversight · $25,000+ Custom Implementation.
- [Forensic Diagnostic ($2,500)](https://aetheris.technology/diagnostic): Operator-led 1:1 forensic walk-through. Fee applied 1:1 toward any follow-on engagement.
- [Implementation Retainer](https://aetheris.technology/implementation): $15K/month execution retainer for Diagnostic clients.
- [Credentials](https://aetheris.technology/credentials): Operator background, Marine Corps service, prior $25M aerospace engagement.
